name: @j0hanz/filesystem-mcp

tools.name: create
tools.description: Write whole text files: create new ones, overwrite, or append. Missing parent directories are created. edit or patch changes part of an existing file.

path.description: Absolute path where the file will be created

append.description: Append the content to the end of the file instead of overwriting; creates the file if it does not exist

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file without asking the user; without it an existing file prompts for confirmation

files.description: List of files to create (max 100); each entry requires path and content; combined content is capped at the file-size limit

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Permanently delete files, directories, or symlinks, like rm or rm -r. Paths are exact; globs are not expanded.

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

paths.description: Paths to delete (max 1000); accepts files, directories, or symlinks

recursive.description: Delete directory contents recursively (required for non-empty directories)

ignoreIfNotExists.description: Silently succeed if a path does not exist instead of returning an error

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two text files and return a unified diff from a to b, like diff -u.

context.description: Number of context lines surrounding each change (default: 3)

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit text files in place by replacing exact oldText with newText, like str_replace. Each oldText must match exactly once, and a file is written only if all its edits match. replace_text replaces every occurrence across files.

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with files

edits.description: Replacements applied to path; not allowed when using files

oldText.description: Exact literal text to locate in the file; it must match exactly once. Include 3-5 lines of context so it does — an oldText found in several places fails with their line numbers.

newText.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the matched oldText.

path.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

oldText.description: Exact literal text to locate in the file; it must match exactly once. Include 3-5 lines of context so it does — an oldText found in several places fails with their line numbers.

newText.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the matched oldText.

edits.description: Replacements to apply to this specific file

dryRun.description: Preview diffs without writing to disk (default: false = apply edits)

ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore leading/trailing whitespace differences when matching oldText

tools.name: list
tools.description: List a directory's files and subdirectories as a tree of names, like ls or tree. stat returns sizes and dates.

path.description: Directory to list (default: first allowed root)

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to traverse (default: 1 = top-level only; increase to recurse deeper)

maxEntries.description: Page size (default: 1000). Continue with nextCursor; an incomplete first page also carries resourceUri for the whole list.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass unchanged for the next page. Pages slice one snapshot taken on the first call; it expires after ~60s — re-request without a cursor if rejected.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move, rename, or copy files and directories, like mv or cp -r. Each destination is the full new path, not a folder to move into; missing parent directories are created.

source.description: Path of the file or directory to move or copy

copy.description: Copy instead of move; sources are left in place

overwrite.description: Copy mode only: overwrite existing destinations without confirmation

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Apply a single-file unified diff to one existing text file, like git apply. Nothing is written unless every hunk applies in file order with exactly matching context; hunks are found by their context, so start line numbers may be off.

path.description: File to apply the diff to

diff.description: Single-file unified diff to apply (as produced by the diff tool or edit dry-run)

dryRun.description: Preview the result without writing (default: false)

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text files, like cat: whole, or one slice via head, tail, or startLine/endLine. Images and audio return as media; other binary files are rejected.

includeHash.description: Include SHA-256 hash of the returned content in the response

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with paths

paths.description: Array of file paths for batch mode (max 1000); mutually exclusive with path

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace every occurrence of literal text or an RE2 regex, like sed -i, in one file or all files under a directory, optionally filtered by glob. The pattern runs over the whole file: it can span lines, and ^ and $ anchor to file start and end. edit replaces one unique exact match.

path.description: File to rewrite, or directory to rewrite under. Omitting it targets the ENTIRE first allowed root — scope it deliberately, and pair a wide scope with dryRun=true first

pattern.description: Glob to restrict replacements to specific file types (e.g. **/*.ts); default: all text files

searchPattern.description: Exact literal text or RE2 regex pattern to search for. When isRegex=true, uses RE2 syntax (no lookahead, lookbehind, or backreferences are supported). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

replacement.description: Replacement text. Use capture group references ($1, $2, etc.) when isRegex=true. Use an empty string to delete all matches.

isRegex.description: Treat searchPattern as a RE2 regex (default: literal text match)

wholeWord.description: Match whole words only (word boundary anchoring)

dryRun.description: Preview replacements without writing to disk (default: false = apply changes)

returnDiff.description: Include a unified diff of all changes in the response

maxResults.description: Maximum total match count across all files before stopping

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to process

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to scan; 0 = base directory only, omit for unlimited

tools.name: list_roots
tools.description: List the directories this server can access, as absolute paths, including any the user granted during this session. Other tools can ask the user to grant access to a path outside them.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search file contents for literal text or an RE2 regex, like grep; returns matching lines with line numbers and paths relative to the searched directory. Patterns match within one line. find_files matches file names.

path.description: File to search, or directory to search under (default: the whole first allowed root). Naming a file searches that file alone: pattern is ignored and hidden/ignored filtering does not apply.

pattern.description: Glob to restrict search to specific file types (e.g. **/*.ts); default: all text files

searchPattern.description: Exact literal text or RE2 regex pattern to search for in file contents. When isRegex=true, uses RE2 syntax (no lookahead, lookbehind, or backreferences). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

isRegex.description: Treat searchPattern as a regex (default: literal text match)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return per page

context.description: Lines of context to return either side of each match, like grep -C (default: 0, max: 10)

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to scan; 0 = base directory only, omit for unlimited

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass unchanged for the next page. Pages slice one snapshot taken on the first call; it expires after ~60s — re-request without a cursor if rejected.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find files by name or glob pattern; returns file paths relative to the searched directory. A pattern without / matches file names at any depth. search_text searches contents.

path.description: Base directory to search under (default: first allowed root)

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths (e.g. **/*.ts, src/**/*.js)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching files to return per page

sortBy.description: Sort order: path = full path (default), name = basename only

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to scan; 0 = base directory only, omit for unlimited

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass unchanged for the next page. Pages slice one snapshot taken on the first call; it expires after ~60s — re-request without a cursor if rejected.

tools.name: stat
tools.description: Get metadata without reading contents, like ls -ld: type, size (files only; use list for directory contents), tokenEstimate, timestamps, permissions (readOnly on Windows), MIME type guessed from the extension, and symlink target. Also checks whether paths exist.

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with paths

paths.description: Array of file paths for batch mode (max 1000); mutually exclusive with path

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

instructions: Navigation guide for filesystem-mcp tools and constraints. Use list_roots to inspect configured or accepted roots, then list/find_files -> stat -> read. Never guess paths. For full guidance, read internal://instructions or run the get-help prompt.
